inputs.working_directory: Directory holding driver and pinned PDB.
inputs.generated: Seeds 1000..1007 for velocities and integrator RNG.
inputs.scale_selection: Single fixed scale from brief; no scale search, adaptive step count or doubling loops.

json_fields.replicas: Eight records with replica, seed, steps, wall_s, final_potential_kj_mol, mean_potential_kj_mol

outputs.full_energy_series_reason: Sampled every 250 steps but not saved by published inline driver.

timing_scope.ensemble_start: Immediately before replica loop, after PDB parse, force-field/system creation and platform selection.
timing_scope.ensemble_end: After all replicas finish and each context/integrator is deleted; before JSON serialization and stdout.
included: Context creation and lazy CUDA compilation
timing_scope.per_replica: Starts after context and velocity initialization; includes integration, energy queries and per-replica result preparation; excludes context destruction.
timing_scope.concurrent_comparison: Time entire ensemble completion on one GPU, including creation and cleanup of every replica context; preserve work, seeds and 100 energy queries per replica. Include candidate orchestration overhead; no warm-up exclusion absent from sequential baseline.

scoring_interface.primary: Minimize total wall seconds for complete fixed ensemble; speedup = sequential_total_wall_s / candidate_total_wall_s.
scoring_interface.scientific_acceptance: Brief predicts identical per-seed energy series on same hardware/software with deterministic forces. Fallback refers to measured sequential run-to-run variation, which is unavailable. No independent published energy acceptance tolerance exists.
scoring_interface.energy_tolerance_reason: No published numeric acceptance criterion; do not use integrator constraint tolerance as outcome tolerance.
scoring_interface.published_performance_acceptance_reason: NVIDIA observations are fixed-time reference throughput, not acceptance thresholds for fixed-work ensemble. Brief speedup ranges are predictions.
scoring_interface.reference_comparison: Report context and units; do not score fixed-work runtime against approximate fixed-time throughput reference.

repeatability.requirements: Same GPU model, OpenMM pin, force fields, initial positions, precision and deterministic-force setting for comparisons.
repeatability.reason: No repeat count or statistical aggregation rule published for supplied fixed-work driver.
repeatability.determinism_status: Unverified on CUDA. Documentation describes deterministic forces but also cautions single-precision PME simulation determinism depends on settings; trajectory identity requires reproduction.

scoring_interface.interface_limitation: Inline driver samples energies internally but serializes only mean and final value; complete time-series equality cannot be audited from ensemble.json alone.

expected_duration.claim: About one minute on H100; a few minutes on slower GPUs.
expected_duration.reason: No CUDA run or compilation-overhead measurement supplied.

budget_feasibility: Fixed-scale duration claim is below default budgets; actual duration remains unverified. No workloads run during intake.
gate_scripts_reason: No gate script path or command supplied; only JSON and evidence consistency validated locally.
